units: pixels (original 2160x1080 image coords, x right, y down) and seconds

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of background between frames 0/35/71 < 0.01 px)
camera.notes: vanishing point of the receding street (road edges) at ~(1078,539) = image centre (1080,540): level camera looking along the street, principal point at the image centre is consistent. Pedestrian pelvis stays at y~545 while they approach -> camera height ~ pedestrian pelvis height. Objects lower in the image (larger ground_y) are nearer: ground contact y: van 615, cyclist 626, taxi 633->712, pedestrian 672->707.

pedestrian.desc: adult man, white T-shirt, blue jeans, white mannequin face; walks on the near-left sidewalk toward the camera and leftward
pedestrian.ref_point: ref_x/ref_y = pelvis estimate (row at 47% of the bbox height from the top; x = mask mean in that row band)
pedestrian.apparent_size: height 242 px (f0) -> 306 px (f71), grows as he approaches

taxi.desc: yellow NYC-style taxi (Ford Crown Victoria type) with roof TAXI sign; side view driving right at start, turns left (toward the camera) and approaches head-on
taxi.ref_point: ref = bbox centre (vehicle root unknown; ground_y = tyre bottoms); mask_cx/cy also given

van.desc: white cargo van (Chevrolet Express type) with brown rear windows; drives left-to-right across the scene on the cross street behind the taxi and the cyclist
van.ref_point: ref = centre of the full (template-reconstructed) bbox; rigid translation, constant image scale
van.apparent_size: constant: length 453 px (rear bumper to front bumper), height 162.5 px (roof 452.5 to tyre bottom 615)

cyclist.desc: rider in dark clothes on a bicycle with white-rimmed wheels, riding left-to-right on the cross street, nearer than the van
cyclist.ref_point: ref = bbox centre of rider+bike; pelvis_x/y = rider saddle/pelvis estimate
cyclist.apparent_size: constant: bike length 134 px (rear rim to front rim), total height 138 px (head top to tyre bottom)

lamp_post_near_left.desc: double-lantern lamp post on the near-left corner; pole x~354, base y~682

litter_bin.desc: dark green slatted bin next to the lamp post (bin body ~362-434 x, 560-672 y on the frame)

traffic_light_near_left.desc: twin traffic-light heads + pedestrian signal, near-left corner

traffic_light_far_left.desc: far-left corner traffic light with pedestrian-crossing sign on top

traffic_light_near_right.desc: near-right traffic light with red triangular pedestrian-crossing warning sign on top

street_lamps_receding.desc: rows of identical small lamp posts along both sides of the receding street, converging to (1078,539)

roads.desc: cross street (horizontal in image, the van/cyclist travel on it, taxi turns off it) and receding street toward the vanishing point; sidewalks with red brick planters at near-left and far corners

events.event: frames 0 and 1 are identical for every object (duplicate first frame); motion visible from frame 1->2
van starts moving from rest (per-frame x step: 0.0, 1.4, 1.8, 2.4, 3.0, 3.4 ...), then accelerates steadily to the end
cyclist already moving at frame 1, steady rightward ~17.81 px/frame (frames 1-71), constant image height

taxi bbox centre reaches its right-most image x (982); taxi has turned from driving rightwards (side view, frames 0-~35) to driving toward the camera (front view from ~frame 44); after this its image x drifts slowly left while it keeps approaching (ground_y rises to the end)
cyclist rear wheel clears the van front bumper in the image (frames 0-9 the cyclist overlaps the van front, partly hidden behind the taxi)
van front bumper reaches the cyclist rear wheel in the image (van, behind the cyclist, starts overtaking it); cyclist occludes van from here
van front passes the cyclist front wheel in the image
van rear clears the taxi right edge in the image (taxi no longer overlaps the van)
end of clip: all four objects still moving
